description: This Java source file defines the `TestTask` class, a subclass of `AbstractTask` that performs a scheduled task. It tracks execution count, logs information during initialization, execution, and shutdown, and throws an exception every 10 executions to simulate failure scenarios.

classes.name: TestTask
classes.description: A scheduled task implementation that logs its activity and simulates failures.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the task with the provided TaskDefinition, logs initialization.

methods.name: setExecutionCount
methods.description: Sets the static execution count to the specified value.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the task actions, logs execution, increments count, and throws exception every 10 runs.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Logs shutdown activity and calls superclass shutdown.
